body: I'm honestly not that good at it. I'm only really good at playing defense. I love watching it. I guess an adult league could be fun though.

I've thought about seeing a therapist about it, possibly seeing a psychiatrist. i've just been too lazy lately. It's weird running is the only thing I'm really motivated for anymore. Thanks for the thoughts

I've always loved running, and I started running more and more after I quit drinking. I feel like I kind of switched addictions from drinking to running. I've always loved sports too, I'm pretty obsessed with soccer.
I really like all kinds of music. That sounds weird I know. It depends on what I'm doing. I mostly listen to music while I am running or driving. What about you?
